[STATE_CHECKPOINT]
COMPLETED: Extracted verbatim sentences from both sources to identify the effective date, duration, scope, activities paused, exemptions, and enacting authority for the Washington County data center moratorium.
REMAINING: Map extracted facts to the user's six specific questions and format as JSON list with fields effective, duration_days, scope, exempt_if_permits_submitted, other. Note the discrepancy between the press release (12 months) and draft ordinance (6 months).
DECISIONS: Need to resolve which duration figure to use (12 months from press release vs. 6 months from ordinance) and whether scope is countywide or limited to unincorporated areas.
CONTEXT: Effective date is June 30, 2026 per both sources. Duration conflict: press release says 12 months, ordinance says 6 months. Scope likely countywide based on language "Washington County". Exemption: no deferral for uses with current Certificate of Use & Occupancy. Enacting authority: Board of County Commissioners. Legal instrument: Ordinance ORD-2026-____.
